For Hino, this was something that should never have happened.
"You bastard... You tricked me."
"What's wrong, Hino? You've gone deathly pale."
With my left hand, I gripped Hino's hand, knife and all, where it was thrust into my stomach.
And with my right, I fumbled the screwdriver out of my pocket.{p}There wasn't a moment to lose.
What do I do?
rows.en:
The next moment, a look of dismay spread across Hino's face.
For Hino, this was something that should never have happened.
"You bastard... You tricked me."
"What's wrong, Hino? You've gone deathly pale."
With my left hand, I gripped Hino's hand, knife and all, where it was thrust into my stomach.
And with my right, I fumbled the screwdriver out of my pocket.{p}There wasn't a moment to lose.
What should I do?

rows.before:
"...I...'ll... cur...se... you... to... de............a............th"
He collapsed.
It wasn't as if I couldn't have seen it coming, Hino taking his own life.
But I couldn't stop him.
I had no chance to stop him, and even if I had, would I have stopped him?
"...If you want to curse me, go ahead and curse me. I'm not afraid of your curse.
Thanks to you, I've found the confidence to live strong."
No answer came back from Hino.
By now he must be riding the train to hell.{p}
rows.en:
"...I...'ll... cur...se... you... to... de............a............th"
He collapsed.
It was by no means unforeseeable that Hino would take his own life.
But I couldn't stop him.
I had no chance to stop him, and even if I had, would I have stopped him?
"...If you want to curse me, go ahead and curse me. I'm not afraid of your curse.
Thanks to you, I've found the confidence to live a strong life."
No answer came back from Hino.
By now he must be riding the train to hell.{p}
edit_notes: 07:1221c: EDIT - clumsy 'It wasn't as if I couldn't have seen it coming, Hino taking...' -> 'It was by no means unforeseeable that...'; 'confidence to live strong' -> 'to live a strong life'

"It's my first time. Sorry if I don't do it right."
An innocent smile.
She frightened me more than the thought of being killed.
"Don't finish it in one blow. I'm the one who gets to deal {a} the final stroke."
I heard Iwashita's voice.{p}

"It's my first time. Sorry if I don't do it right."
An innocent smile.
She frightened me more than the thought of being killed.
"Don't end it in one blow. I'm the one who'll finish {a} off."
I heard Iwashita's voice.{p}

What is this?
Without thinking, I glanced down at the floor.{p}

Something rank, and sweet...
What is this?

This suits a blabbermouth perfectly☆
...This is insane.

It wasn't impossible that a side effect might make the poison even stronger.{p}I'd better not, after all.
rows.en:
There were lots of medicines I'd never even seen before.
Couldn't one of these do the same job as the antidote?
...But wait.
For all I knew, a side effect could make the poison even stronger.{p}I'd better not, after all.
edit_notes: 07:18cf4: EDIT - stiff double negative -> natural narration, same meaning

rows.en:

rows.before:
Sending the bed flying, Hosoda burst out from behind it.
Damn.
I should have checked the bed!
But it was too late now.{p}
rows.en:
Sending the bed flying, Hosoda burst out from behind it.
Oh no.
I should have checked the bed!
But it was too late now.{p}

rows.before:
"Gyaaah!"
The screwdriver stabbed into Hosoda's eye.
Damn.
I rushed over, but Hosoda paid me no mind, rolling around and screaming.
I felt a little sorry for him, but my life was on the line too.
I grabbed Hosoda by the shoulder.
"Where's the ampoule? Answer me."
"Uh... uhh..."
Hosoda didn't answer.
Maybe he couldn't.{p}
rows.en:
"Gyaaah!"
The screwdriver stabbed into Hosoda's eye.
Oh no.
I rushed over, but Hosoda paid me no mind, rolling around and screaming.
I felt a little sorry for him, but my life was on the line too.
I grabbed Hosoda by the shoulder.
"Where's the ampoule? Answer me."
"Uh... uhh..."
Hosoda didn't answer.
Maybe he couldn't.{p}

rows.before:
"Sorry about that, really."
I apologized.
Hosoda looked up at me with teary eyes.
"I don't want to do this, you know. But I've got no choice if I want to live. You understand, don't you?"
"Uh..."
Hosoda nodded, again and again.
It was as if he thought he'd be dead the moment I got in a bad mood.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.en:
"Awfully sorry about that."
I apologized.
Hosoda looked up at me with teary eyes.
"I don't want to do this, you know. But I've got no choice if I want to live. You understand, don't you?"
"Uh..."
Hosoda nodded, again and again.
It was as if he thought he'd be dead the moment I got in a bad mood.{p}Now, what should I do?

rows.before:

If I let him go, wouldn't I just be making another enemy for myself?
...No, it's fine.
I'll let him go.
This kind of thing just isn't like me.
Hosoda is my senior, after all.
As a first-year, it weighs on me to keep doing this to him.
"...Go."{p}

rows.before:

She licked it off with a flick of her tongue and laughed.
"Game over."
No...
This can't be happening.
After everything I went through, this is the end?
Am I just going to die now?
"Oh, I love that look on your face. Come on, show me more and more of how much it hurts to lose. Make that I-want-to-live face."
Fukuzawa said it gleefully.
Her eyes were sparkling.
She really seemed to be having the time of her life.
As I stared at her, a pitch-black rage swelled up inside me.{p}

The shock of the fall had broken the ampoule.
Desperately, I licked up the yellow liquid running out with my blood.
Behind me, Fukuzawa laughed.
"Kyahahaha, no use, no use.
They say you have to drink the whole dose of that antidote, or it's pointless.
If you only drink a little, it actually makes the poison work faster."{p}
rows.en:

The shock of the fall had broken the ampoule.
Desperately, I licked up the yellow liquid as it ran out with my blood.
Behind me, Fukuzawa laughed.
"Kyahahaha, no use, no use.
They say you have to drink the whole dose of that antidote, or it's pointless.
If you only drink a little, it actually makes the poison work faster."{p}
